meta.name: design-taste-frontend
meta.description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为落地页和作品集生成不套模板的前端界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果厌倦了模板化设计，想要有品味的定制前端界面。
copy.tagline_en: Ship non-templated frontend interfaces for landing pages and portfolios.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of templated designs and want tasteful custom frontend interfaces.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 做落地页、作品集和改版时会先读你的需求、推断设计方向,先报一句「设计解读」,再决定用哪套设计系统或风格并写代码,产出不像模板套出来的界面。
howto.when: 当你要求做落地页、作品集,或让某个网站改版时接管。原文明确不用于仪表盘、数据表格和多步产品界面。

say.text: 做一个面向技术买家的 SaaS 落地页,偏 Linear 那种极简
say.note: 它会先给出设计解读再动手写代码

say.text: 这是我现有的网站,想保留品牌资产做一次改版
say.note: 改版会先做审计,再决定保留还是推翻

say.text: 帮我搭一个设计师个人作品集,走编辑杂志风格
say.note: 它会按这个方向挑排版和字体

howto.what_en: Once installed, for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns Claude first reads your brief, infers the design direction, states a one-line design read, then picks a design system or aesthetic and writes the code, so the result does not look templated.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask for a landing page, a portfolio, or a redesign of a site. The brief excludes dashboards, data tables, and multi-step product UI.

say_en.text: Build a SaaS landing page for technical buyers, Linear-style minimal
say_en.note: It states a design read before coding

say_en.text: Here is my current site; redesign it but keep the brand assets
Make me a designer portfolio with an editorial magazine feel
say_en.note: It picks type and layout for that direction
